summary: Compile and assemble complete Coulomb/twist CUDA scenes on macOS using a pinned GPU-free NVIDIA Linux container and the production DeviceCompiler commands.
regressions: NVCC 13.0.88 and PTXAS sm_80 passed all 92 unique kernels in each 416-stage mesh/contact/joint scene, in 26.753 and 26.820 seconds. Both friction variants also passed source lowering and launch/wrapper validation on CUDA and Ascend.
differences: This is real vendor compilation, not device execution. It does not certify another toolkit/device or numerical parity. An open CUDA profiling item records general-collision register pressure/spills. GPU-free containers expose only compiler headers and an isolated build directory; image/source/binary hashes and compiler logs are preserved. Full parity remains stale and unrequested.
